turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was it given a zero?
Then answer me. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

Late assignments from September have nothing to do with this essay, Hale. Go ahead and send everything to the committee, in writing, and I'll send mine to the principal. Now, what do you have on the essay itself?
That's not an answer. Take the zero off, apologise to Owen, and we can talk about the rest.
